newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan's ASE Test sees strong Q2 growth.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan's ASE Test sees strong Q2 growth.

text.p: Taiwan's U.S.-listed ASE Test Ltd said on Friday it expected its second-quarter revenues and net income to rise by more than 40 percent from the same 1996 quarter.

ASE Test, an integrated-circuit testing firm that in 1996 became the first Taiwan firm to list directly in the Nasdaq National Market, is 82 percent owned by Taiwan's IC packaging firm Advanced Semiconductor Engineering Inc.
A statement issued by ASE Test did not give the exact figures but said the expected second-quarter growth in both revenues and net income represented a 20 percent increase over the first quarter.
The statement attributed the growth to rising orders.

"Revenues and net income from Malaysia will show considerable growth, driven by significant new orders from customers across the board," it quoted ASE Test's chief financial officer Joseph Tung as saying.
Tung said the firm's recent relocation of two existing plants in Taiwan's southern Kaohsiung went smoothly.
"We actually anticipate a slight increase in revenues from Kaohsiung for the second quarter," Tung said.
